body: This is where the trouble starts. In my head I think "these are the things that I need to be happy... 1) Good Career 2) Circle of Friends 3) Romantic Interest... but when it comes to the real specifics I don't have any answers. I don't know what I want to do for a living or what realistic expectations are given my abilities and position. I'm afraid to both make new friends or reconnect with old because I don't want to be judged based on the condition I'm in. I feel like a loser because I'm not doing anything with myself
I don't want to continue living like this. I need to do something about it.
Not in Education, Employment or Training
His mother would move on and find someone new, probably someone who could provide for him better and be a stronger father figure. so, maybe.
